entities.summary: Lake Valdayskoye or Lake Valdai is a freshwater lake in the center of the Valdaysky District of Novgorod Oblast in Russia, in the middle of the Valdai Hills. One of the largest lakes in Novgorod Oblast, it has a surface area of 19.7 km2 (7.6 mi2), and the area of its basin is 97.2 km2 (37.5 mi2). The average depth of Lake Valdayskoye is 12 m (39 ft) and the deepest point is 60 m (200 ft). The lake freezes up in early December and stays icebound until early May. The lake is in the center of Valdaysky National Park.
